source_id: BW-LMS-01 Step 1 Faculty Schedules Material
purpose: Verify transition from Material Draft / Unpublished to Material Scheduled when Faculty configures future release
preconditions: Course C101 exists; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 adds course material specifying a valid future release date/time
expected_result: Material is created in Scheduled state with status 201; material remains inaccessible to students

source_id: BW-LMS-01 Step 2 System Releases Scheduled Material
purpose: Verify transition from Material Scheduled to Material Published / Available when release timestamp is reached
preconditions: Material M1 in C101 is in Scheduled state with release_at <= current timestamp
action_or_input: System release task processes scheduled material release
expected_result: Material M1 transitions to Published state and becomes visible/accessible to enrolled students

source_id: BW-LMS-02 Step 1 Faculty Creates Assignment Draft
purpose: Verify transition from No Assignment / New to Assignment Draft upon Faculty creation with required configuration
preconditions: Course C101 exists; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 creates assignment with title, due date, instructions, submission type, and points possible
expected_result: Assignment is stored in Draft state with status 201; assignment is not visible to students

source_id: BW-LMS-02 Step 2 Faculty Publishes Assignment Immediately
purpose: Verify transition from Assignment Draft to Assignment Available for Submission upon immediate publication
preconditions: Assignment A1 is in Draft state; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101; release timing is immediate
action_or_input: Faculty F1 initiates immediate publication of assignment A1
expected_result: Assignment A1 status transitions to Published / Available; visible to students for submission

source_id: BW-LMS-02 Step 3 Student Submits Assignment On-Time
purpose: Verify transition from Assignment Available for Submission to Student Submission Recorded upon valid submission before due date
preconditions: Assignment A1 is Available; Student S1 is enrolled in C101; current time < due date
action_or_input: Student S1 submits work conforming to assignment submission type
expected_result: System records submission with timestamp and student attribution; status is submitted / on-time

source_id: BW-LMS-03 Step 1 Faculty Creates Assignment Draft
purpose: Verify creation of assignment in Draft state with future release date configured
preconditions: Course C101 exists; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 creates assignment providing required fields and future release_at timestamp
expected_result: Assignment is stored in Draft state with status 201

source_id: BW-LMS-03 Step 2 Faculty Publishes Assignment as Scheduled
purpose: Verify transition from Assignment Draft to Assignment Published / Scheduled for Release
preconditions: Assignment A2 is Draft with future release_at; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 publishes assignment A2
expected_result: Assignment transitions to Scheduled for Release; remains withheld from enrolled students

source_id: BW-LMS-03 Step 3 System Transitions Scheduled to Available
purpose: Verify automatic transition from Scheduled for Release to Available for Submission when release time arrives
preconditions: Assignment A2 is in Scheduled state with release_at <= current timestamp
action_or_input: System release task executes scheduled assignment release
expected_result: Assignment transitions to Available for Submission; becomes visible and submittable to students

source_id: BW-LMS-03 Step 4 Student Submits to Released Assignment On-Time
purpose: Verify student can submit on-time to scheduled assignment after release transition completes
preconditions: Assignment A2 is now Available; Student S1 is enrolled in C101; current time < due date
action_or_input: Student S1 submits valid assignment content
expected_result: System records submission with timestamp and student identity

source_id: BW-LMS-04 Step 1 Faculty Grades Recorded Submission
purpose: Verify transition from Student Submission Recorded to Grade Draft when Faculty grades submission
preconditions: Student submission Sub1 exists for assignment A1 in C101; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 enters points and feedback for Sub1
expected_result: Grade is saved in Draft state with grader attribution; draft grade is invisible to student

source_id: BW-LMS-04 Step 2 Faculty Releases Grade and Feedback
purpose: Verify transition from Grade Draft to Grade Released / Student Visible when Faculty triggers grade release
preconditions: Draft grade G1 exists for submission Sub1; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 releases grades for assignment A1
expected_result: Grade G1 status transitions to Released; points and feedback become visible to student

source_id: BW-LMS-05 Step 1 TA Grades Recorded Submission
purpose: Verify transition from Student Submission Recorded to Grade Draft when TA grades submission
preconditions: Student submission Sub1 exists in C101; TA T1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: TA T1 enters points and feedback for Sub1
expected_result: Grade is saved in Draft state attributed to TA T1; draft grade is hidden from student

source_id: BW-LMS-05 Step 2 Faculty Releases TA Draft Grade
purpose: Verify transition from TA-authored Grade Draft to Grade Released when Faculty executes release
preconditions: Draft grade G_ta authored by TA T1 exists; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 releases grades for assignment A1
expected_result: Grade G_ta transitions to Released; student can view released grade in read-only form

source_id: CW-LMS-01 Immediate Release Full Lifecycle
purpose: Verify end-to-end composite lifecycle: Faculty creates draft assignment, publishes immediately, and Student submits on-time
preconditions: Faculty F1 and Student S1 are members of course C101
action_or_input: 1. Faculty F1 creates assignment A_imm; 2. Faculty F1 publishes A_imm immediately; 3. Student S1 submits text content before due date
expected_result: Assignment progresses New -> Draft -> Available; submission is recorded and verified

source_id: CW-LMS-01 Scheduled Release Full Lifecycle
purpose: Verify end-to-end composite lifecycle: Faculty creates draft assignment with future release, publishes as scheduled, system releases, and Student submits on-time
preconditions: Faculty F1 and Student S1 are members of course C101
action_or_input: 1. Faculty F1 creates assignment A_sch with future release; 2. Faculty F1 publishes A_sch; 3. System release task runs; 4. Student S1 submits work
expected_result: Assignment progresses New -> Draft -> Scheduled -> Available; student submission recorded successfully

source_id: CW-LMS-02 Faculty Grading and Release Lifecycle
purpose: Verify end-to-end composite grading lifecycle with Faculty: submission -> Faculty grade draft -> Faculty release -> Student read-only view
preconditions: Student submission Sub1 exists; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: 1. Faculty F1 grades Sub1 (Draft); 2. Faculty F1 releases grade (Released); 3. Student views grade
expected_result: Grade progresses Draft -> Released; student accesses released points and feedback

source_id: CW-LMS-02 TA Grading and Faculty Release Lifecycle
purpose: Verify end-to-end composite grading lifecycle with TA: submission -> TA grade draft -> Faculty release -> Student read-only view
preconditions: Student submission Sub2 exists; TA T1 and Faculty F1 are assigned to C101
action_or_input: 1. TA T1 grades Sub2 (Draft); 2. Faculty F1 releases grade (Released); 3. Student views grade
expected_result: Grade progresses Draft -> Released; student accesses released points and feedback

source_id: BW-LMS-02 Invalid Transition Draft Submission Refused
purpose: Verify submission attempt against Draft assignment before publication is rejected
preconditions: Assignment A_draft is in Draft state; Student S1 is enrolled in C101
action_or_input: Student S1 attempts to submit work to assignment A_draft
expected_result: System refuses submission with HTTP 400 or 403; assignment state is unchanged

source_id: BW-LMS-05 Guard Check TA Release Refused
purpose: Verify TA cannot trigger grade release transition
preconditions: Draft grades exist in C101; TA T1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: TA T1 attempts to trigger grade release transition
expected_result: System refuses release transition with HTTP 403; grades remain in Draft state

source_id: BW-LMS-04 Post-Release Grade Modification Audit Transition
purpose: Verify post-release grade modification retains Released state and transitions audit log to recorded
preconditions: Grade G_rel is in Released state; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 updates points on Released grade G_rel
expected_result: Grade G_rel remains Released with updated points and an audit record is logged with actor and timestamp
